FN-G34VB62-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 378
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/01/2026
Senate Bill 378 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Emergency
Management Agency by an undetermined amount dependent upon the costs associated with
administering the Alabama Dam Safety Program, currently administered by local emergency
management agencies, pursuant to the provisions of this bill. However, the increased obligations
could be offset, partially or wholly, by fees established by the agency as authorized by this bill.
In addition, this bill would decrease the obligations of local emergency management agencies
for the administration of dam and reservoir safety oversight.
